notes: The public vLLM run uses TP=8 and DCP=1. MLA cache is replicated across pure TP ranks, so the per-GPU cache slope remains 61 * (512 + 64) * 2 bytes/token.
The model-loading value is recorded as engine evidence but is not treated as a pure checkpoint-byte target because vLLM loaded residency includes rank-local packing/buffers.
